body:
Every elaborated node keeps its source annotation whole, including its `secondary`: the whitespace and comment runs around it, each piece with its own id and text. Nothing reads an elaboration's `secondary`. The one printer that emits it, `ExpToSegment` in `PreserveExact` mode, runs only from `FastParse`, on parsed source. Yet the elaborated program and its `eval_info_map` go to the eval worker with every request.

This leaves it out.

- **Expressions and patterns:** statics builds them with a new `IdTagged.unwrap_elab`, which rewraps a node without its `secondary` but with its ids.
- **Patterns elaborated as themselves:** a pattern whose elaboration was the source pattern itself, like a `let`'s variable, now gets a stripped copy (`IdTagged.strip_secondary`).
- **No extra pass:** it's done where elaborations are built, so nothing new runs per evaluation. The program also still shares its subterms with `eval_info_map`, so they're marshaled once.

## Sizes

Marshaled bytes of a request's program plus `eval_info_map`, before → after, identical over two runs each:

| program | request | program alone |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/reference/probes.hz` | 48.0 → 24.5 KB (−49%) | 37.6 → 14.5 KB |
| `docs/b2t2/table-api-constructors-leftjoin.hz` | 88.5 → 59.2 KB (−33%) | 70.2 → 40.8 KB |
| `docs/reference/tuples.hz` | 54.3 → 41.8 KB (−23%) | 38.0 → 24.6 KB |
| `docs/reference/tables.hz` | 63.5 → 52.8 KB (−17%) | 45.0 → 34.2 KB |
| `tutorial/27-gradebook-overall-grade.hzt` | 70.2 → 61.7 KB (−12%) | 22.2 → 18.6 KB |

Statics time is unchanged. These are sizes, not round-trip times.

This is independent of #2606 ("Keep the incremental cache in the eval worker"): that PR shrinks the response and the cache half of the request, and this one shrinks the program half. They touch different files.

## Tests

A new group, `ElabSize` (1): a program full of comments elaborates with no `secondary` on any expression or pattern, and still evaluates to 30.

This came from the livelits branch (hazelgrove/hazel#2597, "User-Defined Livelits, as in PLDI '21, and beyond"), where it is `5ed7e36d8f`. There, the eval worker's requests shrank by a quarter, the full local suite passes, and in the browser Tree Care's probe follows an edit.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
